intro.title: Brain Type Test
intro.subtitle: Explore your decision-making preferences through 10 timed choices.

creator.name: Creator Brain
creator.tagline: A wellspring of imagination and innovation. You see the world differently.
creator.description: Your brain is wired for creativity and novelty. You break conventional patterns, generate original ideas, and possess exceptional intuition and imagination. Your artistic sense combined with innovative thinking lets you see what others miss.

analyzer.name: Analyzer Brain
analyzer.tagline: Uncovering truth through logic and data.
analyzer.description: Your brain is optimized for systematic analysis and logical reasoning. You break down complex information, recognize patterns, and make judgments based on facts. Your attention to detail and methodical approach make you exceptionally thorough.

empath.name: Empath Brain
empath.tagline: Reading emotional wavelengths and connecting hearts.
empath.description: Your brain excels at sensing others' emotions and feeling deep empathy. You value harmony and achieve the best outcomes through collaboration. Your warmth and understanding provide great comfort to those around you.

intuitive.name: Intuitive Brain
intuitive.tagline: Piercing through to the essence with a sixth sense.
intuitive.description: Your brain understands the world through intuition rather than logic. You quickly detect hidden patterns beneath the surface and sense future possibilities. Your instinctive judgments are remarkably accurate.

strategist.name: Strategist Brain
strategist.tagline: Designing the big picture and executing with precision.
strategist.description: Your brain is optimized for planning and strategic thinking. You set long-term goals and systematically achieve them while solving problems efficiently. A combination of leadership and analytical ability defines you.

visionary.name: Visionary Brain
visionary.tagline: Envisioning the future and boldly pioneering ahead.
visionary.description: Your brain races toward innovation and adventure. You seek new possibilities and boldly take on challenges, combining creative ideas with the drive to execute. You see futures that others cannot imagine.

guardian.name: Guardian Brain
guardian.tagline: Protecting everyone with stability and care.
guardian.description: Your brain has strong stability and protective instincts. You care for those around you, avoid risks through careful judgment, and create safe environments. Your warm empathy and sense of responsibility stand out.

dynamo.name: Dynamo Brain
dynamo.tagline: Acting instantly and thriving under pressure.
dynamo.description: Your brain is full of action and energy. You move immediately, perform best under pressure, and energize everyone around you. Your quick decision-making and driving force make you a dynamic powerhouse.

about.heading1: How the Brain Type Test Works
about.text1: Ten either-or choices capture preferences such as planning versus acting, novelty versus familiarity, and intuition versus research. Each answer adds weight to related profiles; the highest combined score determines the result.
about.text2: The eight profiles are reflection prompts, not fixed identities. Compare the result with real situations and keep only the observations that help you make a better choice.
about.heading3: What This Quiz Does Not Measure
about.text3: This entertainment quiz does not scan your brain, measure dopamine, diagnose a condition, or replace psychological or medical advice.
